map.依据《民法典》继承编计算法定继承份额: Computes statutory inheritance shares under the Succession Book of the Civil Code
map.📖 查看「法定继承份额计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Statutory Inheritance Share Calculator User Guide"
map.继承份额 = 法定比例分配: Inheritance share = distribution by statutory ratio
map.存在丧偶儿媳/女婿尽主要赡养义务（作为第一顺序）: A widowed daughter-in-law / son-in-law who provided the main support, as a first-order heir
map.有遗嘱（优先按遗嘱，此计算仅供参考）: There is a will, which prevails; this calculation is reference only
map.有形成扶养关系的继子女/养子女: There are stepchildren / adopted children in a supported relationship
map.配偶、子女、父母；继承开始后由第一顺序继承人继承，第二顺序不继承: Spouse, children and parents; on succession the first order inherits and the second order does not
map.兄弟姐妹、祖父母、外祖父母；没有第一顺序继承人时由第二顺序继承: Siblings, paternal grandparents and maternal grandparents; they inherit only where there is no first-order heir
map.婚生子女、非婚生子女、养子女和有扶养关系的继子女: Children born in wedlock, children born out of wedlock, adopted children and stepchildren in a supported relationship
map.生父母、养父母和有扶养关系的继父母: Biological parents, adoptive parents and stepparents in a supported relationship
map.继承遗产份额一般应当均等；对生活有特殊困难又缺乏劳动能力的应予照顾；对尽了主要扶: Shares are generally equal, but heirs in special hardship who lack earning capacity should be given more; those who provided the main support or lived with the decedent may receive more; those able to provide support but who did not should receive nothing or less
map.被继承人未立遗嘱时，按第一顺序继承人（配偶、子女、父母）均等分割遗产。: Where the decedent left no will, the estate is divided equally among the first-order heirs, that is the spouse, children and parents.
map.存在丧偶儿媳/女婿尽主要赡养义务的，作为第一顺序继承人。: A widowed daughter-in-law or son-in-law who provided the main support inherits as a first-order heir.
map.有遗嘱的，遗嘱继承优先于法定继承。: Where there is a will, testate succession prevails over intestate succession.
map.遗产 200 万元，第一顺序为配偶 + 2 名子女（父母已故），3 人均等，每人: An estate of ¥2,000,000 with the spouse and 2 children as first-order heirs, the parents having died, is split three ways at about ¥666,700 each.
map.遗产 200 万，继承人为配偶、1 子女、父、母共 4 人，每人 50 万元。: An estate of ¥2,000,000 with four heirs, the spouse, 1 child, the father and the mother, gives ¥500,000 each.
map.子女包括非亲生的吗？: Do children include those not biologically related?
map.包括婚生子女、非婚生子女、养子女和有扶养关系的继子女；尽了主要赡养义务的丧偶儿媳: Yes: children born in or out of wedlock, adopted children and stepchildren in a supported relationship; a widowed daughter-in-law or son-in-law who provided the main support also inherits in the first order.
map.遗嘱和法定继承冲突怎么办？: What if a will conflicts with intestate succession?
map.遗嘱继承优先；但缺乏劳动能力又没有生活来源的继承人应保留必要份额，该部分不受遗嘱: Testate succession prevails, but an heir who lacks earning capacity and has no source of income must be left a necessary share, which the will cannot reduce.
